pattern: \b(?:here(?:'s| is) the thing|let(?:'s| us) dive in|here(?:'s| is) what you need to know|let(?:'s| us) break (?:it|this) down)\b
message: Staged opener may announce the point instead of stating it.
Check whether the negative half corrects a real belief.
rewrite: If not, state the positive claim directly.

pattern: \b(?:that(?:'s| is) the real win|let that sink in|read that again|and that changes everything)\b
message: Dramatic closer may repeat the preceding point.
rewrite: Cut it unless it adds new information.

pattern: \b(?:pivotal moment|game[- ]changer|groundbreaking|transformative|stands as a testament|marks a new era|paradigm shift)\b
rewrite: Keep the concrete fact unless the significance is sourced.

message: Business jargon is a weak signal; check for a missing actor/action/result.
rewrite: Use concrete actors and actions when the source provides them.

message: Stock model vocabulary is weak alone; act only when clustered with other signals.
rewrite: Replace only when a plainer or more precise word fits the context.

pattern: \b(?:in conclusion|to sum up|all in all|at the end of the day)\b
message: Check whether the conclusion adds information or merely restates the body.
rewrite: End on the last concrete fact or decision when possible.

pattern: \b(?:experts say|research shows|studies show|many believe|it is widely believed)\b
message: Vague attribution may borrow authority without a source.
rewrite: Name the source if present; otherwise remove the unsupported authority cue.

pattern: \b(?:could potentially|might arguably|potentially possibly|in some cases it may)\b
message: Stacked qualifiers can make a claim mechanically hedged.
rewrite: Keep only the uncertainty actually required by the source.

pattern: \b(?:I hope this helps|if you(?:'d| would) like, I can|below I(?:'ll| will)|now let(?:'s| us) look at)\b
(?:^|\n)\*\*(?:Key takeaway|Why it matters|Bottom line|The big picture):\*\*
message: Repeated bold labels can create a templated assistant voice.
rewrite: Use normal prose or headings only when the structure genuinely helps.

pattern: \b(?:the future looks bright|exciting times ahead|the possibilities are endless|only time will tell)\b
message: Generic future-looking send-off may add no supported information.
rewrite: End with a sourced plan, constraint, or concrete fact instead.
